name: linkedin
description: LinkedIn profile setup, authenticated self-profile reads, user-supplied profile research briefs, and post draft review through a compliant local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Set up profile copy, read the signed-in member profile, and research user-supplied profile text.
interface.longDescription: LinkedIn gives Gilbert Codex a compliant MCP surface for setup guidance, authenticated member self-profile reads through official APIs, profile optimization plans, user-supplied profile research briefs, and LinkedIn post draft review. It does not scrape LinkedIn, automate browsing, update profile fields, or publish posts.

Read my authenticated LinkedIn profile and suggest improvements.
Create a research brief from this LinkedIn profile text I pasted.
